queries.text: Series title follows the glossary proposal "Man’s Suffering in Love" (O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem). Alternatives: "The Romantic Suffering of Men", "Men’s Suffering in Love".

Subtitle "Apontamentos sobre um Perfil Comportamental Feminino nas Relações Amorosas com o Homem". Alternatives: "Observations on a Female Behavioral Profile in Love Relationships with Men", "Notes on a Feminine Behavioral Profile...".
The citation gives the English titles; the Portuguese originals are "Como Lidar com Mulheres" and "O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem". Consider adding the English edition’s year once published.
The author’s notice explicitly forbids translation and any change of title or language. Translated faithfully; a human should confirm that this English edition is authorized before publication.
Nietzsche, Thus Spoke Zarathustra, “Of Old and Young Women.” Translated from the author’s Portuguese. Public-domain English translation (Thomas Common): “Thou goest to women? Do not forget thy whip!”

Translated from the author’s Portuguese (Almeida Bible). Public-domain English alternative (KJV, Eccl. 7:25–26): “I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things... And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.”
